title: 71 Offences under Local and Special Laws: Disposal of cases by the Police : 27,99,137 offences under Local and Special Laws were under investigation with the police during 1973 including cases pending from the previous years. 1-0 per cent of the total cases were dropped due to various reasons such as mistake of fact or cases found to be non-cognizable or in which investigation was refused. The highest percentage for such cases was in respect of customs Act (22-1 percent) but it is based on very few cases i.e. 68 cases only. Practically no case was dropped under the offence 'suppression of immoral traffic in women and Girls Act'.
